items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Joe Saito' in a list of people recalled, but Interviewee does not mention Joe Saito or describe a personal relationship.

ctx.x: So you were saying about these -- the goodness of musicians and especially trombone players and the great Tony Bennett and how he gave you an opportunity to sort
of revamp yourself and how everybody -- Joe Saito and Tony Studd and Wayne Andre and you recalled many others that --
Uh-huh. Well, do you know, to me there's two instruments in the band that they always seem to be close to one another. Trombone players have always been close to one another and so have bass players.
